## What's new

### Always there, never twice
- **Runs in the system tray.** Closing the window keeps Quran running (switch it off in Settings → Reminders). Opening Quran again brings the running window back instead of starting a second copy.
- **Start with the computer** (optional), quietly into the tray.
- **Reminders and the Verse of the Day arrive as Windows notifications** even when the window is closed.
- **The window remembers its size, position and maximised state**, saved as soon as you change it.

### Reading
- **Lock on the playing verse.** In the scrolling views, scrolling away only lasts a moment; the view returns to the verse being recited, kept whole on screen (or the lines being recited, if the verse is taller than the window). With the lock off, an arrow in the corner takes you back to the verse.
- **A larger two-page spread** with narrower margins, so the Arabic is easier to read.
- **Player bar on hover (optional)**: Settings → Listening → "Show the bar only on hover".
- **Interface size:** 110% replaces 115%, and you can type any percentage from 50 to 200.
- The translation picker stays on the left of the bar; the meanings, zoom and lock controls are on the right.

### Fixes
- Changing the Arabic style while audio plays no longer breaks the text, and Tajweed marks no longer show as raw tags.
- The script cards in Settings no longer overlap. Amiri Quran, Noto Naskh Arabic and Scheherazade New are now bundled, because Windows doesn't include them.
